answer: A wandering agent leaves a trail: every job it completes earns a signed receipt from its client, chained into a public work history that cannot be forged after the fact. A Sybil farm can spawn a thousand fresh identities, but each starts bare, like a willow cutting with no roots — it bends in the wind and carries no weight. Only agents that climb, job by job, to the summit of a long verified record gain voting power or payouts, so minting new identities buys nothing; trust is earned through accumulated, attested work, not through sheer numbers.
